setup: You are given an angle of [[given]]° and asked for the angle in [0°, 360°) that shares its terminal side.

steps.say: Coterminal angles share a terminal side, so they differ by whole turns: adding or subtracting 360° repeatedly carries the angle around the circle without changing where it stops. The given angle and the reduced one differ by [[turns]] full turn(s).
Reducing [[given]] into [0°, 360°) leaves [[value]]°, and that is the only coterminal angle in that range.
